body.title: Delete the temporary reader allowance
body.summary: Delete declareLiveStoreReaderUntilS11, _mayReadLiveStore and the call in the MCP server; remove the store-child 'declare-reader' command; turn the reader cases of live-store-owner.test.ts and live-store-refusal.test.ts into refusal cases; replace the 'exactly two places' scan with one that fails on any occurrence and builds the name from pieces; run and record the full sweep under Node 22.
acceptanceChecks: the name occurs nowhere under src/
the MCP server's process is refused the live graph store and the live vector store
the full sweep is recorded with nothing newly failing

tests.name: source scan: the reader declaration's name appears nowhere under src/
refusal of a third process: beside the owner, a process with no declaration is refused the live graph store and holds no descriptor
ac6: the MCP server's process is refused the live graph store and the live vector store
